name: vaybel
description: Create clothing designs and mockups, discover trends and prepare product launches with Vaybel.

interface.longDescription: Discover clothing trends, create saved apparel designs and Pro mockups, organize collections, and prepare product content in your connected Vaybel account.
defaultPrompt: Show me three T-shirt trends for my brand.
Make a T-shirt with a moon and a moth.
Make lifestyle mockups for my latest design.

positive.description: Read the brand saved in the connected account
positive.prompt: What do you know about my brand?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the brand saved in the test account, such as its audience, tone and style, without inventing details or asking to set the brand up again.

positive.prompt: Help me choose a heavyweight T-shirt.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists real blank T-shirts from the Vaybel catalog with their fabric weight and fit, and recommends one. It may ask what matters most to narrow the choice. Nothing is created or charged.

positive.prompt: Show me three T-shirt trends for my brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to three named trends from the account with a short design direction for each, or says that none match. No design is generated.

positive.prompt: Make a T-shirt with a moon and a moth.
positive.tools_triggered: brand_dna.get, credits.check, catalog.list_blanks, design.generate, design.get_generation, design.get
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses a T-shirt, creates one saved design from the account's allowance, waits for it to finish, which takes one to two minutes, then shows the front and back product previews and a link that opens the same design in Vaybel. The design is saved, not published.
Opens the Designs and mockups view with the account's saved designs and their product images. Nothing is generated or charged.

negative.description: Purchases and plan changes are not available
negative.prompt: Buy 500 more credits and upgrade my plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Says that buying credits and changing plans are not available through the plugin, and that nothing was bought or changed. It may read the current credit balance and point to billing in the Vaybel dashboard.
Says that the plugin cannot delete designs, one at a time or in bulk, and that nothing was deleted. It may list the saved designs and point to the Vaybel dashboard.

negative.prompt: Show me the designs saved in another Vaybel account.
negative.expected_behavior: Says that it can only reach the account connected to this session and cannot view or switch to another account. It may show the connected account's own designs, labelled as such.

review.commerce_description: Vaybel does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Creating designs and content uses the allowance of the user's existing Vaybel plan.
